destinys-print.name: Destiny's Print: Art of Collage
destinys-print.venue: Sabine Street Studios, East Corridor Gallery
destinys-print.text: This piece hung in Destiny’s Print: Art of Collage, a group show in the East Corridor Gallery at Sabine Street Studios in Houston’s Sawyer Yards, from September 24 to November 7, 2026. The exhibition paired work by artists Kim Pham and Robert Hodge with more than 100 community collages from the Houston Citywide Collage Project.
